pages.text: Blue Skies adds two $(t2)T2$() dimensions: Everbright (light/order) and Everdawn (dark/chaos). Elemental combat throughout.$(br2)$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Elemental damage in Blue Skies bypasses standard armor. Magic resistance (Sorcery tree, $(thing)Battlemage$() class) is more valuable here than raw armor stats.$(br2)$(bold)Bosses:$() Summoner, Alchemist, Starlit Crusher, and Arachnarch each drop a Simply Swords unique.$(br2)$(bold)IridescentCraft notes:$() Blue Skies has 641 loot tables - they've been bulk-covered by the loot overhaul. Token injection rates are slightly higher here than Twilight Forest to account for the dimension's density.$(br2)$(bold)No guide book.$() Blue Skies is exploration-driven. Both dimensions - the Everbright and the Everdawn - contain dungeon loot and boss encounters that guide you forward naturally. JEI covers all crafting recipes.
